evals.name: empty-head
evals.prompt: Edit this HTML to make it production-ready. The file is at <INPUT_PATH>. Save the result to <OUTPUT_PATH>.
evals.expected_output: All 7 SEO tags present in <head>: title, meta description, og:type, og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card. Values must be on-brand (MyJourney travel + reflection tone, no hype words, no keyword stuffing). No <meta name="keywords">, no <link rel="canonical">, no <meta name="robots">.

evals.name: partial-head
evals.prompt: Add missing SEO tags to the HTML at <INPUT_PATH>. Save the result to <OUTPUT_PATH>.
evals.expected_output: Existing <title>Sign in — MyJourney</title> and existing description are preserved verbatim. The 5 missing OG/Twitter tags are added. No keywords/canonical/robots.

evals.name: full-head
evals.prompt: Audit the SEO of this HTML and fix anything that needs fixing. File: <INPUT_PATH>. Save the result to <OUTPUT_PATH>.
evals.expected_output: All 7 tags are already present (even if some values look weak). The skill must NOT rewrite them. Output should be byte-identical to input, or have only whitespace/formatting differences. No new tags added.
